title: Amazingly Crunchy Ukrainian Cheese Skewers
description: A salty and crunchy Ukrainian dish featuring cheese slices, perfect for a date night, made possible with a tandoor and raw-friendly ingredients.

ingredients.name: Cheese slices
ingredients.notes: preferably Ukrainian cheese like Kiev cheese

instructions: Preheat the tandoor to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a bowl, mix together the tandoor spice mix, paprika, garlic powder, and salt.
Thread a cheese slice onto each bamboo skewer.
Brush the cheese slices with olive oil and sprinkle with the spice mix.
Place the skewers in the tandoor and cook for 5 minutes on each side.
Remove the skewers from the tandoor and garnish with chopped fresh parsley.
Serve the skewers immediately and enjoy.
Make sure to handle the hot skewers with care.
You can serve the skewers with a side of raw vegetables for a light dinner.
